summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by BMW Auto Leasing LLC and BMW Vehicle Lease Trust 2026-1 reporting the entry into a material definitive agreement related to a securitization of auto leases. The registrant is issuing multiple classes of asset-backed notes (Class A-1 through A-4) totaling approximately $1.5 billion, along with associated trust and transfer agreements. There are no terms regarding a change of control, merger, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation. This filing is a standard current report for a structured finance transaction and does not constitute a special situation.
